title: Comment “Code” and I’ll send you the link👇
description:
Comment “Code” and I’ll send you the link👇 

Coding with AI has never been easier. The real bottleneck moved to review.

You can ship code fast with Cursor or Claude, but someone still has to catch the bugs and security holes.

There’s also a built-in AI chat,
so you can ask questions about the code without leaving your PR.

#aitools #coding #github #aicoding #softwareengineering
